BJP Plans Seat Distribution for UP Elections Based on Winnability

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is preparing to strategize seat distribution with its alliance partners for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The party's plan focuses on allocating seats based on the likelihood of winning, potentially fielding its own candidates in closely contested constituencies. Meanwhile, a preliminary meeting between the Congress and Samajwadi Party (SP) regarding seat sharing in UP concluded quickly after just 20 minutes.
